Personnel Directory

The Office is organized into three divisions. Staff may be reached through Form 27-B/6 or by mail at info@officeofordinaryhauntings.net. Please do not telephone. Please, in particular, do not telephone after dark.

Neil Daigle Orians

Title:
Senior Investigator
Division:
I — Material Phenomena
Focus:
Residue, impression, and memory in clay, paper, and glass

Investigator Orians approaches the work from a position of belief and has been observed to enjoy it. Maintains that materials remember. Has not been contradicted by the materials.

Wes Modes

Title:
Senior Investigator
Division:
II — Mechanical & Computational Phenomena
Focus:
Terminals, printers, and devices that produce output when no operator is present

Investigator Modes maintains a position of professional skepticism, which the apparatus is currently testing. Shares an office with Investigator Orians. This has been noted.
